title: RenoLayout: Unified Floorplan Renovation and Furniture Layout for Constraint-Aware Residential Design
abstract: arXiv:2610.21366v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Residential design aims to transform existing homes into functional living spaces while satisfying diverse design preferences and physical constraints. However, existing floorplan generation methods typically assume empty building boundaries as input, whereas renovation requires reasoning over existing floorplans. Furthermore, floorplan renovation and furniture layout are commonly addressed as separate tasks, overlooking their inherent spatial dependency. Consequently, practical residential design must preserve immutable structural components while transforming editable spatial elements. It must also optimize furniture placement under design objectives and physical constraints. To address these challenges, we formulate residential design as a design-point-guided conditional generation task and propose RenoLayout, a framework that translates a pre-design residential state together with a design-point set into an executable Geometry-as-Cod

translated_title: RenoLayout：面向约束感知住宅设计的统一户型改造与家具布局
translated_abstract: 住宅设计旨在将现有住宅改造为功能性的居住空间，同时满足多样化的设计偏好与物理约束。然而，现有的户型生成方法通常假设以空置的建筑边界作为输入，而改造任务则需要基于现有户型进行推理。此外，户型改造与家具布局通常被作为两个独立任务处理，忽视了二者之间固有的空间依赖关系。因此，实际的住宅设计必须在转换可编辑空间元素的同时保留不可更改的结构组件，并需在设计目标与物理约束下优化家具摆放。为应对这些挑战，我们将住宅设计形式化为一个由设计点引导的条件生成任务，并提出RenoLayout框架，该框架将改造前的住宅状态与设计点集合共同转换为可执行的“几何即代码”（Geometry-as-Code）表示。
tldr: 该论文提出RenoLayout框架，首次将户型改造与家具布局统一为设计点引导的条件生成任务，通过“几何即代码”表示在保留不可变结构组件的同时，生成满足设计目标与物理约束的可执行住宅改造方案。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes RenoLayout, a unified framework that formulates floorplan renovation and furniture layout as a design-point-guided conditional generation task, translating pre-design residential states into executable Geometry-as-Code while preserving immutable structural components and satisfying design objectives and physical constraints.
